title: Is it time to buy LQMT Liquidmetal? $LQMT – Stocks News Feed
text:
Is this the time to buy shares in $LQMT Liquidmetal Technologies inc? As of today the shares are trading in the $.13 range, which seems to be a great entry price for a long term investment. On the last 10Q the company had 36.4M in cash and restricted cash, 49.1M if you take into account property equipment, patents, and other assets, and minimal liabilities 501k. Having an outstanding 909M shares, this puts the shares at about only twice it’s cash value.
You will also notice on the previous 10Q that the company actually had some revenue, more than in previous times. Could this be from $ AAPL Apple? It is rumored that they new Apple iWatch 4 is made from Liquid Metal. Apple even mentions that the Liquid Metal face is inspired by the materials that make the apple iWatch. The thing is, no PR has been released from either; could one be coming?
On Dec. 12th LQMT got an approval for a power upgrade on their facility. This is a big power upgrade! www.lakeforestca.gov/212/Current-Projects-and-Recent-Decisions
